title: Eiffel Tower 'pollution' prank on a fellow viewer

tellings.quote: I said, "Oh, by the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who served in the 1980s in a military remote viewing unit, a team that tried to describe distant targets using only the mind, says he once played a prank on a fellow viewer. He says he told the man, "By the way, your target today is probably not the Eiffel Tower," planting an image in his head to spoil, or 'pollute', his session.
